cloudSync.title: Sync
cloudSync.intro: Sync reading progress, bookmarks, notes, favorites and folders to your own cloud storage. Book files are not part of sync.
cloudSync.unavailable: Secure storage or certificate checks are not available on this device, so it cannot connect. Reading is not affected.
cloudSync.recoverySaved: This device's sync record was damaged. A copy was kept and sync was disconnected. Your library was not changed; you can connect again.
cloudSync.field.password.jianguoyun: On the Jianguoyun website, add an app under Account Info → Security to get a third-party app password. Not your sign-in password.
cloudSync.field.password.custom: Your WebDAV password or an app-specific password.
cloudSync.passwordNote: The password is kept only in this system's secure storage and never goes into the synced data.
cloudSync.preview.existing: This folder already has sync data: {books} books from {devices} devices. Connecting merges it with this device; neither side is overwritten.
cloudSync.preview.new: This folder has no sync data yet. Connecting creates it.
cloudSync.preview.issues: {count} device files could not be read and were skipped.
cloudSync.pendingNote: Changes on this device are waiting to sync.
cloudSync.issues: {count} files from other devices could not be read and were skipped; their data may be out of date.
cloudSync.devices.empty: No device has uploaded data yet.
cloudSync.cloudBooks.note: These books are not on this device. Import the same book and its progress and notes come back.
cloudSync.disconnect.confirm: Disconnecting keeps the books and reading data on this device and the data in the cloud.
cloudSync.identity.title: This device needs a new writer identity
cloudSync.identity.detail: The cloud has files with this device's writer identity, perhaps copied from another device. A new identity lets this device continue as a new device; the old device record is not deleted.
cloudSync.error.invalid-config: The address, account or device name is not valid.
cloudSync.error.native-bridge-unavailabl: Secure storage or certificate checks are not available on this device.
cloudSync.error.credential-unavailable: The password could not be read or saved. Please connect again.
cloudSync.error.credential-cleanup-faile: The new connection is saved, but the old connection's password could not be removed from the system.
cloudSync.error.probe-expired: The test result has expired. Please test the connection again.
cloudSync.error.confirmation-required: The cloud data changed after the test. Please test again and confirm.
cloudSync.error.space-changed: The cloud data set was replaced, so sync stopped. Check the cloud folder, and disconnect and reconnect if needed.
cloudSync.error.unsupported-sync-version: The cloud data comes from a newer version of the app. Please update this app first.
cloudSync.error.unsupported-local-versio: This device's sync record comes from a newer version of the app. Please update this app first.
cloudSync.error.storage-error: Could not read or write this device's sync record.
cloudSync.error.local-state-invalid: This device's sync record is damaged. Disconnecting keeps a copy; your library is not affected.
cloudSync.error.repository-not-ready: The library is not ready yet; sync will retry by itself.
cloudSync.error.writer-identity-conflict: This device's writer identity conflicts with a cloud file, so uploads stopped.
cloudSync.error.own-file-unread: This device's last upload could not be confirmed, so uploads stopped.
cloudSync.error.event-collision: Duplicate records in the cloud data were skipped.
cloudSync.error.busy: Another sync action is in progress.
cloudSync.remote.invalid-config: The server address is not valid.
cloudSync.remote.authentication: The account or app password is wrong.
cloudSync.remote.permission-denied: No permission to use this folder.
cloudSync.remote.not-found: The server could not find this folder or address.
cloudSync.remote.conflict: A cloud file conflict occurred. Test the connection again or retry manually later.
cloudSync.remote.locked: A cloud file is locked; sync will retry.
cloudSync.remote.rate-limited: Too many requests; the server asked to wait.
cloudSync.remote.unsupported: This server lacks WebDAV features needed for safe sync.
cloudSync.remote.unsafe-redirect: The server redirected to another address, which was not followed for safety. Enter the final address.
cloudSync.remote.unsafe-creation: This server cannot create the sync data safely.
cloudSync.remote.invalid-response: The server's response could not be understood.
cloudSync.remote.size-limit: The cloud data is over the size limit.
cloudSync.remote.timeout: The connection timed out; sync will retry.
cloudSync.remote.network: Network connection failed; sync will retry.
cloudSync.remote.unsupported-sync-versio: The cloud data comes from a newer version of the app. Please update this app first.
cloudSync.remote.cleanupFailed: Some temporary files could not be cleaned up. Retry first; do not delete published sync data.
cloudSync.upload.dock.tip: Upload the selected books' original files to the connected cloud drive
cloudSync.upload.title: Upload Original Books
cloudSync.upload.noneReady: None of the selected books can be uploaded.
cloudSync.upload.notConnected: No cloud drive is connected yet. Connect Jianguoyun or another WebDAV drive in Settings → Sync, then come back to upload.
cloudSync.upload.cancelingNote: Books already saved to the cloud drive stay there. Cleaning up this batch's unfinished temporary file.
cloudSync.upload.foreground: Keep the app open while uploading. On a phone, switching away stops this upload.
cloudSync.upload.detached: A batch of original books is uploading (started before the app reloaded). Its per-book results cannot be shown here.
cloudSync.upload.detachedEnded: That earlier upload has finished. Its per-book results were not kept; select the books again to upload, and books already in the cloud drive are skipped.
cloudSync.upload.title.completed.other: All {count} original books are in the cloud drive
cloudSync.upload.title.completed.one: {count} original book is in the cloud drive
cloudSync.upload.title.partial.other: Upload finished; {count} books did not make it
cloudSync.upload.title.partial.one: Upload finished; {count} book did not make it
cloudSync.upload.stopped.quota-exceeded: The cloud drive is full; upload stopped
cloudSync.upload.stopped.authentication: The account or app password is wrong; upload stopped
cloudSync.upload.stopped.permission-deni: No permission to write to the cloud drive; upload stopped
cloudSync.upload.stopped.unsupported: This cloud drive cannot store original books; upload stopped
cloudSync.upload.stopped.space-mismatch: The sync space on the cloud drive changed; upload stopped
cloudSync.upload.stopped.connection-chan: The cloud connection changed; upload stopped
cloudSync.upload.notAttemptedLine.other: The remaining {count} books were not started.
cloudSync.upload.notAttemptedLine.one: The remaining {count} book was not started.
cloudSync.upload.keptLine.other: The {count} books already uploaded stay in the cloud drive.
cloudSync.upload.keptLine.one: The {count} book already uploaded stays in the cloud drive.
cloudSync.upload.cleanupPending: An unfinished temporary file from this batch is still on the cloud drive; the next upload cleans it up.
cloudSync.upload.error.busy: Another upload or import is running. Upload again when it finishes.
cloudSync.upload.error.connection-requir: No cloud drive is connected, or the connection was removed.
cloudSync.upload.reason.timeout: No progress for too long; stopped
cloudSync.upload.reason.remote-conflict: A different copy of this file is already in the cloud drive
cloudSync.upload.reason.rate-limited: Too many requests; the server asked to wait
cloudSync.upload.reason.locked: The file is locked on the cloud drive
cloudSync.upload.reason.unsupported: The cloud drive cannot store original books
cloudSync.upload.reason.conflict: File conflict on the cloud drive
cloudSync.upload.reason.unsafe-redirect: The server asked to redirect; refused
cloudSync.upload.reason.unsafe-creation: The server cannot create files safely
cloudSync.upload.reason.size-limit: Over the cloud drive's size limit
